meaning_en: to be in contact
quote: have you been in touch with Elliott?
quote_cn: 你和 Elliott 还有联系吗？
example: Keep in touch with me after the handover.
example_cn: 交接完以后跟我保持联系。
note: 职场/关系高频。get in touch with＝联系上。

meaning_en: to put money into an account
quote: Could you not deposit this until Monday?
quote_cn: 这张支票能不能先别存到周一？
example: She deposited the cheque the morning the rent was due.
example_cn: 房租到期那天早上她才去存的支票。
note: 英式拼 cheque／deposit，美式 check。名词 a deposit ＝订金/押金。

meaning_en: a feeling of slight pain or unease
quote: Call if the discomfort's too much.
quote_cn: 要是不舒服得受不了就打给我。
example: The side effects cause discomfort rather than pain.
example_cn: 副作用带来的是不适而不是疼痛。
note: discomfort／discomforting／discomforted。搭配 at ease 的反义。

meaning_en: a process where substances combine and change
quote: Explosions are the result of chemical reactions happening almost instantaneously.
quote_cn: 爆炸是化学反应几乎瞬间发生的结果。
example: The reaction releases heat and changes the colour.
example_cn: 这个反应会放热并改变颜色。
note: 动词 react；名词 reactant（反应物）／product（产物）。

meaning_en: in an instant
quote: chemical reactions happening almost instantaneously
quote_cn: 几乎瞬间就发生的化学反应
example: The two compounds react instantaneously on contact.
example_cn: 这两种化合物一接触就瞬间反应。
note: 形容词 instantaneous。≈ in an instant。

meaning_en: to keep secret or not reveal
quote: is there anything else you're holding back from your family?
quote_cn: 你是不是还有什么瞒着家里？
example: He held back the numbers until the audit was done.
example_cn: 他把数字瞒到审计结束才说。
note: hold sth back＝藏着不说；hold someone back＝拖住某人。

meaning_en: to stop shutting them out emotionally
meaning_cn: 让某人进入你的世界；对某人敞开心扉
quote: Walt when you don't let me in
quote_cn: Walt，你把我关在门外的时候……
example: Managers who don't let people in lose their best staff.
example_cn: 不让人敞开心扉的管理者会失去最好的员工。
note: 情感义。in 用于关系，into 用于场合（let you into the team）。

meaning_en: to have no information and be kept guessing
quote: we're just left wondering where you are
quote_cn: 我们只能干等着猜你在哪儿。
example: Supporters were left wondering whether the site would ever return.
example_cn: 支持者只能等着，不知道网站还会不会回来。
note: be left + V-ing＝被动地处在某种处境。

meaning_en: having a healing or calming effect
meaning_cn: 有疗愈作用的；让人放松的
quote: It's really very therapeutic.
quote_cn: 这真的很有治愈感。
example: Gardening turned out to be unexpectedly therapeutic.
example_cn: 园艺意外地很治愈。
note: 名词 therapy／therapist。口语也指「像在做治疗一样」。

meaning_en: feeling very hot, often with fever
quote: I'm burning up.
quote_cn: 我烧得厉害。
example: He was burning up by the time the ambulance arrived.
example_cn: 救护车到的时候他已经烧得很厉害了。
note: 发烧说法。＝ have a fever。也可指「着火了」。

meaning_en: to look extremely pale and haggard
meaning_cn: 脸色苍白憔悴（像刚从微波炉里爬出来）
quote: looks like you just crawled out of a microwave.
quote_cn: 你看起来就像刚从微波炉里爬出来。
example: After three red-eyes he looked like he crawled out of a microwave.
example_cn: 连熬三个通宵后他憔悴得不行。
note: 美式俚语。同类：look like death warmed over。

meaning_en: to die
quote: You want to make some cash for your people before you check out.
quote_cn: 你是在想着趁还在的时候给家里留点钱。
example: He paid off the house before his father checked out.
example_cn: 他在父亲去世前把房贷还清了。
note: 极委婉说法。更正式的 euphemism 是 pass away。

meaning_en: a small organ that filters lymph
quote: Gone to your lymph nodes.
quote_cn: 已经扩散到你的淋巴结了。
example: Stage two means it has reached the lymph nodes.
example_cn: 二期意味着已经扩散到淋巴结。
note: 复数 lymph nodes。淋巴系统，癌症分期关键指标。

meaning_en: a phase of a disease's development
quote: What stage are you?
quote_cn: 你这是几期？
example: It was caught at stage one, which is why the outlook is good.
example_cn: 是一期发现的，所以预后还不错。
note: 医学义＝分期；通用义＝阶段。stage I/II/III/IV。

meaning_en: chemotherapy
quote: The next time, put an ice pack on your head during chemo.
quote_cn: 下次化疗的时候头上敷个冰袋。
example: He did six rounds of chemo and kept working.
example_cn: 他做了六个疗程的化疗，还一直在上班。
note: 口语缩写，正式 chemotherapy。＝ chemo treatment／chemo session。

meaning_en: to complete a set of work done in one run
quote: You going to be able to finish the batch?
quote_cn: 这批你做得完吗？
example: We have to finish the batch before the shift ends.
example_cn: 这批必须在下班前做完。
note: batch＝一批；生产/后厨/实验室通用。

meaning_en: a lot of money
quote: I'm out there making fat stacks, man.
quote_cn: 我在外面赚着大把钞票呢，老兄。
example: He's making fat stacks on the used-car lot.
example_cn: 他在二手车行赚得盆满钵满。
note: 俚语。a stack ＝一叠（通常 1000 美元）。

meaning_en: to sell drugs, especially to buyers
quote: I've been out there all night slinging crystal.
quote_cn: 我整晚在外面兜售冰毒。
example: He got busted for slinging weed out of his apartment.
example_cn: 他因为在公寓里卖大麻被抓。
note: 名词 a slinger＝毒贩。同义 peddle、deal。

meaning_en: an amount of drugs large enough to trigger a felony charge
quote: but would you be interested in a felony quantity of methamphetamine?
quote_cn: 但你对大量冰毒有兴趣吗？
example: He was arrested with a felony quantity of cocaine.
example_cn: 他被查到持有大量可卡因，按重罪起诉。
note: 美国法律分级：misdemeanor（轻罪）／felony（重罪）。

meaning_en: near the top of a hierarchy
quote: look, he's upper level, man.
quote_cn: 你看，他是大人物，老兄。
example: Only upper-level staff see the full financial data.
example_cn: 只有高层员工能看到完整的财务数据。
note: 职场层级：entry-level／mid-level／upper-level／executive。

meaning_en: to deal or trade with them
quote: He's not going to do business with some dude he doesn't know.
quote_cn: 他不会跟一个他不认识的人做生意。
example: We don't do business with anyone under forty.
example_cn: 我们不跟四十岁以下的人做生意。
note: 常见搭配：do business with／in。＝ have dealings with。

meaning_en: to approach someone forcefully with no introduction
quote: You can't just bum rush some high-level ice man and start cutting deals, okay?
quote_cn: 你不能直接硬闯去找一个大毒枭谈交易，明白吗？
example: Don't bum rush the CFO — get an introduction first.
example_cn: 别硬闯 CFO 的办公室，先找个人引荐。
note: 职场也有：别一上来就找老板硬谈。

meaning_en: to negotiate and agree terms
meaning_cn: 谈成一笔交易；达成协议
quote: We got a deal.
quote_cn: 成交。
example: They cut a deal that kept both vendors alive.
example_cn: 他们谈成了一笔让两家供应商都活下来的协议。
note: 职场超高频。＝ strike／close a deal（签成）。

meaning_en: to be introduced to someone useful
quote: You need an intro.
quote_cn: 你需要一个引荐。
example: Can you get me an intro to the head of design?
example_cn: 你能帮我引荐一下设计负责人吗？
note: intro 是 introduction 的口语缩写。＝ warm introduction。

meaning_en: to speak in support of their character
quote: You need someone to vouch.
quote_cn: 你得有人替你说句话。
example: Will your former manager vouch for you?
example_cn: 你以前的经理愿意替你作保吗？
note: ＝ back／endorse。vouch for sth 也可作「保证某事属实」。

meaning_en: in serious trouble
quote: the last thing I want to do is get you in hot water
quote_cn: 我最不想做的就是把你牵扯进麻烦里。
example: Two junior analysts got in hot water over the same spreadsheet.
example_cn: 两个初级分析师因为同一份表格惹上了麻烦。
note: 同义 in a tight spot、in trouble。get in hot water＝惹祸。

meaning_en: a wild scramble for something
quote: some meth monkey had a feeding frenzy in here
quote_cn: 有个瘾君子在这儿翻箱倒柜翻疯了
example: Reporters went into a feeding frenzy when the story broke.
example_cn: 消息一出记者们立刻扑上去抢新闻。
note: 原义动物抢食。＝ frenzy 狂热；frantic 疯狂的。

meaning_en: to watch something or someone closely
quote: You got to keep a better watch over your turf.
quote_cn: 你得把自己的地盘看紧点。
example: Someone needs to keep a watch over the loading bay at night.
example_cn: 晚上得有人盯着装货区。
note: keep watch on／over。turf＝地盘（俚语）。

meaning_en: to be on close friendly terms
quote: you're sure you're tight with this guy?
quote_cn: 你确定你跟这家伙关系很好？
example: He grew tight with the warehouse crew.
example_cn: 他跟仓库那帮人混得很熟。
note: tight with＝关系近。tight with cash＝抠门。

meaning_en: a really nice place
quote: Sick crib, yo.
quote_cn: 这房子真带劲，老兄。
example: His new crib has a rooftop deck.
example_cn: 他新住处有屋顶露台。
note: 俚语。crib＝住处／房间。＝ dope／sick／ill。

meaning_en: being honest and not pretending
quote: You been keeping it real since you been sprung.
quote_cn: 你出来之后一直挺本分的。
example: I appreciate that you keep it real with me.
example_cn: 我很感谢你跟我说实话。
note: 口语。＝ being real、straight with me。

meaning_en: released from custody
quote: since you been sprung
quote_cn: 自从你被放出来
example: He was sprung two weeks after the arrest.
example_cn: 被捕两周后他就被放出来了。
note: slang。反义 locked up。也可作 spring 跳出。

meaning_en: to start a conversation in an awkward situation
quote: Break out the ice.
quote_cn: 来，share 一点。
example: He opened with a joke to break the ice.
example_cn: 他用一句玩笑破冰。
note: 源自破冰航行。职场社交/谈判开场必备。

meaning_en: selling goods on behalf of a supplier
quote: This is a consignment operation.
quote_cn: 我们这是寄售的生意。
example: Consignment means the retailer only gets paid after the item sells.
example_cn: 寄售意味着零售商要等货卖出去才拿钱。
note: ＝ consignment wholesale。寄售 vs 买断（buyout）。

meaning_en: to provide money upfront and hope to recover it
quote: You want me to float 35 G's?
quote_cn: 你要我先垫三万五？
example: The vendor floated payroll until the invoice cleared.
example_cn: 供应商先垫发了工资，等发票回款。
note: 职场财务义＝垫付。float income ＝非固定收入。

meaning_en: paying immediately before delivery
quote: Cash up front.
quote_cn: 现钱，一手交钱。
example: Their policy is 50% cash up front and 50% on delivery.
example_cn: 他们的政策是一半预付一半交货时付。
note: 职场/贸易。up front＝事先；预先。

word: I have two words for you
meaning_en: my whole answer in one phrase
meaning_cn: 我给你两句话就说完了
quote: I got two words for you: background check.
quote_cn: 我给你两句话：背景调查。
example: Had I two words for you: read the contract.
example_cn: 我给你两句话：把合同读完。
note: 口语，强调答案极短。＝ long story short。

meaning_en: that is just how I operate
meaning_cn: 我就是这么混的／这就是我的路数
quote: because that's how I roll
quote_cn: 因为我就这德行
example: I take the long way — that's how I roll.
example_cn: 我就爱绕远路，这就是我的风格。
note: roll＝风格、路子。同类：that's just the way it is。

meaning_en: to match a description of the suspect
quote: Fit the profile.
quote_cn: 完全符合画像。
example: His background fits the profile we drew up.
example_cn: 他的背景符合我们梳理出来的画像。
note: 职场也常用：fits the profile for the role＝符合这个岗位的画像。

meaning_en: official permission to search a place
quote: we got a search warrant, and we tore old Hugo's house apart
quote_cn: 我们拿到了搜查令，把 Hugo 家翻了个底朝天
example: They cannot enter without a search warrant.
example_cn: 没有搜查令他们不能进去。
note: arrive vs execute a warrant。同类 warrant＝授权令。

meaning_en: to search it thoroughly and messily
quote: we tore old Hugo's house apart
quote_cn: 我们把 Hugo 家翻了个底朝天
example: Auditors tore the books apart looking for the gap.
example_cn: 审计为了找账目缺口把账翻了个遍。
note: tear apart 也可指「拆解分析」，＝ break down。

meaning_en: a habitual cannabis user
quote: Turns out he's a major league pothead.
quote_cn: 结果他是个十足的大麻鬼。
example: major league pothead ＝ 严重的大麻瘾者
example_cn: （例句同上）
note: 俚语。major league＝「严重的/顶级的」，职场也用（major league screw-up＝天大的失误）。

meaning_en: to give someone a particular impression
meaning_cn: 给人的感觉是；让人觉得
quote: Hugo just doesn't strike me as the thief.
quote_cn: Hugo 给我完全不像小偷的感觉。
example: Her pitch struck me as too polished to be true.
example_cn: 她的提案给我的感觉是打磨过头，不像是真的。
note: it strikes me（that）＝ 我觉得。形容词的近义：come across as。

meaning_en: to get past checks that should have caught it
meaning_cn: 从缝隙里漏过去；被蒙混过关
quote: How could something like that just slip through the cracks?
quote_cn: 这种事怎么能就这么漏过去呢？
example: A contractor with an expired licence slipped through the checks.
example_cn: 一个执照过期的承包商混过了审查。
note: 职场质量管理高频。＝ fall between the cracks。

meaning_en: as a minor concession of value
meaning_cn: 说句公道话；不过怎么说呢
quote: I mean, for what it's worth
quote_cn: 怎么说呢，参考一下
example: For what it's worth, I read the whole document.
example_cn: 说句公道话，整份文件我看了。
note: 缓冲语。也可作 for what it is（就其价值而言）。
